topics.label: Introduction to the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides opening framing by introducing the importance, complexity, and scope of the lecture on complement.

topics.label: Foundational principles, nomenclature, and the central role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational overview, naming conventions, and core biochemical mechanisms governing the activation of complement component C3.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three distinct recognition pathways that initiate complement activation and converge on the threshold deposition of C3b.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the primary downstream effector functions through which complement destroys pathogens and mediates immune responses.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the regulatory factors and inhibitory mechanisms that protect host cells from unintended complement-mediated damage.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic analyzes the distinct disease presentations and clinical phenotypes resulting from deficiencies across various complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how pathogens evolve specialized mechanisms to circumvent and neutralize complement attack.

topics.label: Lecture wrap-up and preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing administrative remarks and a preview of the next lecture topic.
